# SS STUDIO

> SS STUDIO designs and builds premium websites, digital experiences and AI-powered systems for modern businesses.

## Overview
SS STUDIO is a specialized digital studio combining business strategy, bespoke visual design, high-performance React/TypeScript engineering, and intelligent workflow automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Strategy & Direction**: Business research, digital positioning, information architecture, conversion strategy.
- **Design & Interfaces**: Bespoke UI/UX, design systems, art direction, interaction design, motion systems.
- **Engineering & Performance**: React, TypeScript, Vite, GSAP, Three.js WebGL, responsive multi-device architecture.
- **AI & Business Systems**: AI product experiences, guided product selectors, lead qualification funnels, workflow automation.

## Portfolio & Case Studies
- [Forge Flow (Manufacturing Industry Demo)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/forge-flow): Precision manufacturing digital platform and interactive guided pump selection engine.
- [Atelier Forma (Interior & Architecture Concept)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/atelier-forma): Architectural monograph and spatial design portfolio.
- [Ember & Grain (Café & Specialty Coffee Concept)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/ember-grain): Specialty coffee roastery and atmospheric culinary experience.
- [Lume (Fine Dining Concept)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/lume): Contemporary fine dining and tasting progression experience.
- [Axis Structures (Construction & Civil Engineering Concept)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/axis-structures): Structural engineering and civil infrastructure platform.
- [Verra Residences (Real Estate Concept)](https://ss-studio.vercel.app/work/verra-residences): Luxury residential property launch monograph.
